title: Executive Dashboard
description: This project was done as a part of Office Depot 2019 Internship Case Competition in a team of 6 people, one of which was working remotely with the rest of us.
In the team I was fulfilling the roles of the Tech Lead and Designer.

The goal of the project was to create a working executive dashboard prototype, which would display useful information in the form of graphs, gauges, KPIs, etc. The data would come from a variety of sources, but mainly from Salesforce. It would then be parsed and displayed to the screen via a web dashboard application Qlik.
The dashboard would be accessible on desktop and mobile devices.

title: Better UCF Parking
description: This project was initialized in HCI class at UCF. We, as a team of 5 students, had to design an interface for our imaginary mobile app. But we decided to build on and improve the design and functionality of the current UCF parking app.
Later, during my internship at Office Depot where I learned React-Native, I created a visual prototype which worked on both IOS and Android.

title: Reus Auto
description: A Python-based desktop automation tool that allows you to create and run macros for automating repetitive tasks. It's utilizing image recognition for element selection on the screen.
Provides a variety of built-in functions to create macros for automating tasks:
- Mouse control (click, double-click, right-click, drag, etc.)
- Keyboard input (typing, key presses, key combinations, etc.)
- Window management (open, close, minimize, maximize, etc.)
- Delay management (pause, wait for a specific event, etc.)
- Image recognition (locate an element on the screen, etc.)
